title: link-orm
summary: Links a project's code index to a SQL index so ORM-style relationships between Delphi symbols and SQL objects can be resolved across both
intro: Read this when you want queries that cross from Delphi code into the SQL schema it talks to. It links a project index to a SQL index so ORM-style relationships between code symbols and SQL objects can be resolved across both.

questions.ask: How do I link my code index to a SQL index?
